newsitem.title: CHINA: Group forms for Philippines Dev Bank yen bond.
newsitem.headline: Group forms for Philippines Dev Bank yen bond.

text.p: A group has formed for Development Bank of the Philippines' 20 billion yen fixed rate notes due September 2, 2003, lead manager Daiwa Securities said.
The six-year notes were priced at 99.84. They pay a 3.15 percent coupon semi-annually to yield 3.18 percent, or 110 basis points over the six-year yen/yen swap rate.
Gross fees are 50 basis points for co-lead managers and 40 basis points for co-managers.
Daiwa Securities Co Ltd is the lead manager.

Daiwa Securities (HK), DKB Asia, Nomura International (Hong Kong), Sumitomo Trust, Yamaichi International (HK), IBJ Asia, ING Barings, Kokusai Securities (Hong Kong), LTCB Asia, Merrill Lynch (Asia Pacific) and Tokyo-Mitsubishi International are the co-lead managers.
Metrobank, PCI Capital Corp and RCBC are co-managers.
